verification.note: Breadcrumb.tsx:54 declares `ancestorSegments`, and Breadcrumb.tsx:89 spreads them into the items. FileDetailChrome.tsx:198 and queue/QueueTrail.tsx:26 use it. Breadcrumb.tsx is not in the touch-point list.

useInspectorFit.ts:28 adds `extraRowWidth`, and useInspectorFit.ts:100-101 adds it to rowWidth. FileDetailShell.tsx:104-108 (`inlineSidebarWidth`) reads the padding-left of main's parent, and FileDetailShell.tsx:215 passes it in. useInspectorFit.ts is not in the touch-point list.

AppShell.tsx:387-390 gives main's parent `min-[1200px]:pl-60` whenever the sidebar is inline. TwoPaneLayout.tsx:174 asks for the overlay form only when `treeBeside || yielded`, so with the tree off and no visit the 240px padding stays. inlineSidebarWidth (FileDetailShell.tsx:104-108) still returns it, and useInspectorFit.ts:100-116 adds it to the row. The threshold is 60.5rem = 968px (layoutSizes.ts:15-16). At the default 16px root font, a viewport of 1200-1207px therefore measures `beside` for a row of about 960px, where the right form is stacked/overlay. With a larger root font the window widens: at 20px it is about 1200-1509px, because pl-60 and the threshold scale with rem while the 1200px breakpoint does not.
frontend/src/lib/treeVisitStore.ts exists. TwoPaneLayout.tsx:29, 117-133 and 156 use it. It is not in the touch-point list.

All five files and fixtures/queuePage.tsx exist at the commit, and none is in the touch-point list. A grep for collection/COLLECTION in those five files finds nothing, which is consistent with the collection cases having been removed. I did not inspect the base side of the diff.

The listed tests exist (e.g. components/queue/__tests__/queue.test.ts, folder/__tests__/TwoPaneLayout.queuePane.test.tsx, app/drive/[name]/__tests__/layout.queue.test.tsx), and none is named in the touch-point list. FileDetailChrome.tsx:70-81 uses queuePage.name/href for the back control whenever a QueuePage is provided. FileDetailChrome.tsx:195-202 drops folderPath and passes the queue as the only ancestor. FolderQueueHost.tsx:268-272 provides a QueuePage for every isQueue (folder and smart), with href = trailHref (FolderQueueHost.tsx:205, which falls back to the drive root) and name possibly "" (FolderQueueHost.tsx:194-199). Effect: a nested folder queue loses its intermediate ancestor crumbs, and a Smart queue on the drive root adds a Smart crumb. I28 allows a different trail only on a collection page, and I7 limits the trail difference to D2, which is collection-only.

CollectionDetail.tsx:444 passes `queuePane={fileId !== null}`. TwoPaneLayout.tsx:125-131 clears treeVisitStore whenever `queuePane && hasFile` is false, so clearing ?file= on the collection page ends the visit. With the setting off, the pane is then hidden (TwoPaneLayout.tsx:180-182, w-0). This contradicts spec §1 Collection step 12 ('On a collection page the visit ends when the page is left') and I19 ('the listing shows the pane ... or a queue pane is shown for the visit on a collection page').

unspecified_scores.reason: After Play all on a folder the user had already sorted in the URL, × or a choice outside the queue drops that sort too, and the listing returns to its default order.
With the tree off, opening any collection file (even from a grid card) shows the item pane beside it, which matches the spirit of step 3 and is harmless.
With Autoplay off, choosing a row in the collection pane before any file is open does not start playback, so the user must press play, which contradicts the expectation that a queue action starts it.
Only for a cold Smart queue URL while the smart-folders read is pending or failed: the trail briefly shows an empty crumb linking to the drive root.
A user who hid the visit-shown pane sees it come back after resizing across md or reopening a file, and must hide it again.
Only after a navigation guard cancels a queue selection: a later arrival at the same file autoplays once regardless of the preference.

specification_compliance: I28/I7: the folder and Smart queue trails differ from today's FileDetailChrome trail, although the spec allows a different trail only on a collection page (F7 confirmed).
I19 and §1 step 12: a visit-shown pane ends on clearing ?file= instead of on leaving the collection page (F8 confirmed).
